scripts.allure:reset: rm -rf allure-results && mkdir -p allure-results && (cp -r allure-report/history allure-results/history 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.test:all: npm run allure:reset && wdio run config/wdio.conf.js
scripts.test:smoke: npm run allure:reset && wdio run config/wdio.conf.js --spec tests/specs/smoke.spec.js
scripts.bs-android: npm run allure:reset && wdio run config/wdio.browserstack.conf.js
scripts.report: npm run report:generate && allure open allure-report
scripts.report:arquivo: D="relatorios/$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H%M)" && allure generate allure-results --single-file --clean -o "$D" && (cp -r screenshots "$D/evidencias-de-falha" 2>/dev/null || true) && echo "Relatório salvo em $D/index.html"
